title: GE Walking Truck - Cybernetic Anthropomorphous Machine (CAM) 1969.
summary: Short footage of the General Electric Cybernetic Anthropomorphous Machine, or Walking Truck, a 1960s quadruped vehicle operated by a human driver using hydraulic limbs. The uploader notes it predates Big Dog by decades.
why: HN cites it in robotics threads as proof that legged machines were mechanically feasible in the 1960s, long before Boston Dynamics.

quote.text: The mechanics are almost academic as is evidenced by the GE walker from 1965
